The origin is the joint land-registry and cadastre system; updates are weekly.

countries.scope: Romanian ANCPI parcel service; a small Bucharest query was attempted

officialEvidence.finding: Indexed official metadata identifies a Cadastral Parcel polygon layer, supports JSON/GeoJSON and query operations, and advertises a 1000-record limit. This is a documented vector API, not just a raster viewer; no live geometry response was obtained.
The official catalogue identifies RO.ANCPI/CP.ETERRA.WFS and an INSPIRE cadastral-parcels download service, updated 2026-06-16. Its download distribution points to the ANCPI Geoportal host.

The official notice dated 20 August 2026 says e-Terra was restored while other services, including Geoportal, would restart in stages. No replacement Geoportal hostname was found in the bounded current-site check.

countries.decision: Inconclusive access check, not evidence of no parcel data. Keep grey until a geometry response or verifiable downloaded artifact is available.
